notes: AMELIA POWERS GARDNER, 2022, Utah County Commission - the chunk's largest filing (43 contribution rows / 41 expenditure rows) and A DIFFERENT 2022 BLANK from the Pomeroy filing read earlier in this chunk. *** THE SECOND 2022 FORM, CHARACTERISED *** EIGHT pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover; pp2, 3 and 4 all 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received'; pp5, 6 and 7 all 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made'; p8 'Summary Page' LAST. (1) NO PRINTED VERSION STRING - the footer carries only the three contact bullets, where the v. 4.20 stock prints 'v. 4.20'. index.csv records the variant as modern_boxAF with version '?', and that is right. (2) THE SCHEDULES HAVE FIVE COLUMNS, NOT FOUR: Date / Name of Contributor (or Provider/Vendor) / CITY AND STATE / Amount / IN-KIND CHECKBOX. Two changes matter. The address column is now 'City and State' by design, so no street address is ever printed - privacy by form, and the first blank in this corpus for which the read-time reduction is a no-op. And the IN-KIND CHECKBOX is the first dedicated in-kind field seen in Utah County; on this filing exactly one box is ticked. (3) THE COVER GAINED A SIXTH REPORT TYPE, 'End-of-Year Report - Due on December 31 for current County and local school board officers', alongside the five on the v. 4.20 blank; the boxes are SQUARE CHECKBOXES rather than radio circles; the affirmation block is now correctly headed 'Affirmation' (the v. 4.20 blank mislabelled it a second 'Type of Report'); and a 'Date of Filing' box replaces the 'Date of Report / Page' box, WHICH MEANS THIS BLANK HAS NO PAGE-NUMBER FIELD AT ALL - the filing is unfoliated, and completeness rests on the pdfinfo count and on the schedule totals reconciling across all three sheets, both of which they do. (4) THE CLOSE BOX IS LETTERED 'G' on this revision. Addendum I3 records it as UNLETTERED on v. 4.20, which is correct for that stock; this is a different blank and it prints the G. (5) The Schedule B PURPOSE column is present and every one of the 41 rows fills it. MIXED TYPED / HANDWRITTEN FIGURES, AND THE HANDWRITING IS LOAD-BEARING: the Schedule A sheet-2 subtotal (21,190.29), the Schedule B sheet-3 subtotal (2511.26), the Schedule B sum-of-all-pages total on all three sheets ($56,428.08), the whole of Schedule B sheet 3 row 11, and Boxes D, E and G on the Summary Page are all HANDWRITTEN in black pen over the printed form; everything else is machine type. Each handwritten figure was crop-proved and each is confirmed by the arithmetic it gates. REPORT TYPE: 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election' is ticked and the amendment question is answered No. The signature is a script-font digital signature, Date 6/21/22, with a matching Date of Filing 6/21/22. Page-face office reads 'Utah County Commission' WITH NO SEAT, while index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat A'. NO SEAT WAS INFERRED from the page - the filing does not print one, and per the standing rule that is recorded rather than resolved. Page-face candidate agrees with the channel label. PRIVACY: the county published this filing unredacted, but the schedules print only city and state, so nothing had to be dropped there; the cover's street line, phone and email were read and deliberately not carried. DATES: EVERY contribution row's date is a bare M/D with NO YEAR (all three Schedule A sheets), kept verbatim with needs_review=1 on all 43 rows - a year is never filled in from the report date. The expenditure sheets do carry years, and sheet 1 switches format mid-page from M/D/YY to M/D/YYYY; both kept verbatim. Schedule A sheet 3 runs in DESCENDING date order. Columns were assigned by CONTENT as well as position (field-shift screen): every date cell holds a date, every name cell a person or organisation, every city/state cell a city and state, every purpose cell a purpose - no inversion. Two vendor cells name an occasion rather than a payee ('Orem Summerfest Parade', 'Fundraiser') and SIX name several vendors at once ('Chevron, 7-11, Exxon'); all are flagged and kept as the single rows the document reports, never split into imagined vendors. All six row-index traps screened on all six schedule sheets: the first written entry is band 1 everywhere (crop-proved), no continuation line, no voided row, no banner line, nothing below the last printed rule (crop-proved on the FOUR FULL sheets p2, p3, p5 and p6, where the risk is real), and no doubled band - every grid is uniform-pitch at ~3.99 and every sheet closes to the cent on its own subtotal. NO CHECKLIST IS BOUND INTO THIS FILING: all eight pages are report pages and only p8 carries the summary labels, each with a figure.
